name: A Door That Is Not There

system.description:
Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You trace a doorframe in the air. An image of weathered wood and an iron latch settles into the space, convincing until a hand passes through it.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
A visible unoccupied square within 4 squares.
Duration
Ten minutes, unless ended earlier as stated above.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Place a silent, flat illusion of a door, window, screen or similar scene feature. It lasts 10 minutes; touch reveals it, and it blocks neither attacks nor movement.

Weak
The image holds while you remain still.
Standard
The image holds while you move.
Strong
It also includes small natural movement, such as a shifting curtain.
